notes_for_editor: Identity unconfirmed. The only record is an OSM way with name, man_made=tower, tower:type=observation and a condition note; no register (NHLR or FFLOS), staffing, or news record found. The OSM changeset comment on the way reads 'Revamp lookout peak trail system', which may be a lead. The 1999 CEQAnet notice for the Ukiah Forest Fire Station (CDF) is the only nearby CDF item found; it does not mention a tower, so the story does not link them. The FFLA California list has no CDF Lookout entry. Iron Peak (CEQAnet 1986, a CAL FIRE antenna-tower lease in Mendocino County) was checked and is not a match: the FFLA list places Iron Peak at 39.81, -123.48. Two web searches used. Pages read: OSM way (two fetches), CEQAnet Ukiah notice, CEQAnet Iron Peak notice, FFLA California list.
